status: development-only diagnostics; HOLDOUT MUST REMAIN UNINSPECTED until candidate formula is frozen

protocol.rule: No holdout outcomes, bucket statistics, correlations, threshold tuning, or candidate comparisons may be used during v3 design.
protocol.goal: Model explicit state transitions rather than map trailing momentum monotonically to forward return.

stateDefinitions.trend_persistence: 5D SOX >2%, 10D >3%, 5D RS >0.5pp, breadth >=60%, current day non-negative.
stateDefinitions.uptrend_pullback: 10D SOX >3%, 10D RS >1pp, current day negative but >-3%.
stateDefinitions.confirmed_recovery: 5D and 10D still negative, current day >0.5%, 1D RS positive, breadth >=60%.
